content: Mfuul ntɔn bɔr
Ntɔn ndaa lan'söön bɛ, yà ubwaŋ naa mbuur ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abääl.
Ntɔn mukɔɔn abwà unsà ŋingyäy, wɛy baal wanswà ukäl anà un'kyay ande, un'kaar wanswà ukäl anà un'dim ande.
Wɛy un'dim ukwey buur ande akà un'kyay ande, anà un'kaar ukyer sye abun kusà a un'dim ande.
Un'kaar ikɔ̈b kyatɛy u ndür ande ŋakwo, wɛɛ un'dim ande awe anà kya. Ifà imwɛy sye, un'dim, ikɔ̈b kyatɛy u ndür ande, wɛɛ un'kyay ande awe anà kya.

Wɛɛ bɛ twon lan'tsuŋ umwɛy anà wumwɛy, nà isàkal naa, unsà ukwen umwɛy anà utaaŋ làmwɛy là ikikye, ntɔn bɛ làpɛ taaŋ unsà ngyamàkà, waa làfàfurà kà un'tüüb, manà naa Satanà uyàsyääl ukɔɔn nkäŋ a mpem abɛ mukàlabwiy.
Ndaa amàlakyään mɛ yi, yà an'kyän mpɛl mɛ an'pà, wɛɛ ya kà yà nswɛɛŋ anki.
Mɛ in'kwen naa abaal banswà bàkäl asànaa mɛ, wɛɛ mbuur mbuur we anà kab a nsöön kun'pɛ Nzam, umwɛy ntɔn là, wumwɛy ntɔn lanà.
Apanà, mɛ in'tɛn a ampfwe anà akweel adim naa yà ubwaŋ mukal aŋàyen, asànaa mɛ.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa ba nkääŋ a mpem yatɛy, wɛy ba bàbääl, ntɔn yà ubwaŋ mubääl, akwànaa muwulà mbaa a làmfɛɛl.
Wɛɛ akà baar abàŋàbääl, mɛ amàlaswaŋ, kà mɛ anki, wɛɛ Mwol: wɛy un'kaar ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akaabà anà un'dim ande,
isàkal naa nde kàkyàkaabà, wɛy nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n àfàbääl, itàkal naa nde uyöŋà a un'dim ande. Wɛy un'dim sye ukɔ̈ɔ̈n awɛy un'kyay ande.
Akà bamwɛy, mɛ in'tɛn abà, kà Mwol anki: isàkal un'tɔŋ abaal wɛ anà un'kyay mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ un'kaar awà kan'kyey mukal anà nde, wɛy nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akun'wɛy.
Ifà imwɛy sye, isàkal naa un'kaar we anà un'dim mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà, wɛɛ baal awà kan'kyey mukal anà nde, wɛy nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akun'wɛy.

Ntɔn, un'dim mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà kan'bulà aŋin'kyɛɛl u mbwo a un'kyay ande, anà un'kyay mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà kan'bulà aŋin'kyɛɛl u mbwo a un'dim ande wàŋàlàkwikilà. Isàkal naa kabwɛy tɛy, baan abɛ bàyàkal mbiin, kyekà ba bà bàŋikyɛɛl.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa mbuur mpa awà ŋàlàkwikilà kan'kwen mudwa bɔr, wɛy nde ukyer abun! Un'tɔŋ wàbaal itàkal wun'kaar kà wàŋàteen anki unsà indiir abi. Nzam kàlabeel ntɔn bɛ làkäl unsà duu.
Abun, un'kaar, ngye ayöb aben naa ngye asàtswà un'dim angye mɔ̈ɔ̈? Itàkal un'dim, ngye ayöb aben naa ngye asàtswà un'kyay angye mɔ̈ɔ̈?
Mukal unsà mbeel a Nzam.
Abun, wɛy mbuur mbuur usyen mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande unsà kab alà kun'pɛ Mwol, asànaa kàkäl nde utaaŋ kun'bel Nzam. Ayi nswɛɛŋ amɛ unsà Ikööŋ byanswà.
Nkye mbuur mwɛy kàkäl aŋàkyɛy utaaŋ bun'bel? Wɛy nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n aye nkyɛɛy ande. Nà mpa kàkäl aŋàkyɛy utaaŋ bun'bel? Wɛy bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kyɛy.
Nkyɛɛy yundiir a bunàbun, ukɔɔn nkyɛɛy wundiir a bunàbun, wɛɛ undiir a mfun wà mulab nswɛɛŋ a Nzam.
Wɛy mbuur mbuur ukäl asànaa kàkäl nde utaaŋ bun'bel.
Nkye ngye kàkäl un'sɔ utaaŋ babel? Twon an'kyɛɛr. Wɛɛ, itàkal naa ngye an'bulà nsaay, syääl isɔ angye.
Ntɔn, un'sɔ bàbel uboo a Mwol, nde wà nsaay a Mwol. Ifà imwɛy sye, mbuur bàbel wà nsaay, nde wà un'sɔ a Mwol.
Mbuur mwɛy kàkyàfur ntal a nkwiy ntɔn bɛ. Twon lan'fàbulà asɔ a baar.
Atɔŋ, wɛy mbuur mbuur ukäl kusà a Nzam asànaa kàkäl nde utaaŋ bun'bel.
Ampfwe anà akweel adim.
Ntɔn ankɔr, mɛ nswɛɛŋ a Mwol yatɛy: mɛ an'kyän in'pà, an'kyän a mbuur mwɛy ban'kwo musà làkyän, u nsyääm a Mwol.
Ntɔn mpay a taaŋ alà, mɛ in'manà naa yubwaŋ naa mbuur mbuur ukäl asànaa awà nde.
Nkye ngye awàŋàtüüb anà un'kaar? Twon an'leŋ mukaabà. Nkye ngye kawàŋàtüüb anki anà un'kaar? Twon an'leŋ un'kaar.

Isàkal naa ngye an'bääl, ngye akyer anki man'be. Isàkal naa unkɔr un'kaar kan'bääl, nde man'be ukyer anki. Wɛɛ baar bàŋàbääl bye anà buur a ndür mbɔɔn, wɛɛ mɛ in'kwen naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà buur a ndür abà.
Atɔŋ, mɛ in'kwen mutɛn abà: taaŋ lan'bulà ikökö. Sɛmà apanà, wɛy mbuur wanswà awe anà un'kyay ukäl asànaa nde wa watɛy,
baar bàlelà asànaa ba bàlelà anki, baar bàsaŋà asànaa ba bàsaŋà anki, baar bàsoomà asànaa ba undiir watɛy,
baar bàsyäälà indiir a mɛɛn mà asànaa ba bya bàsyäälà anki. Ntɔn mɛɛn mà abà, mà mulyaŋ.
Mɛ in'kwen anki naa bɛ làkäl anà nkyɛɛr. Mpfwe mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande wanswà wà unsà indiir a Mwol: nde afàleŋ naa nde Mwol un'sak kun'pà aben.
Wɛɛ, baal aŋàbääl an'kyän mà unsà indiir a mɛɛn, nde aleŋà naa nde un'kyay ande un'sak kun'pà aben,

anà mpem ande yàŋàkaabà. Ifà imwɛy sye, un'kaar unkɔr asànaa un'sye, an'kyän ande mà unsà indiir a Mwol, ntɔn nde ukäl ŋun'kyɛɛl u ndür anà u dweelà. Wɛɛ un'kaar aŋàbääl an'kyän ande mà mɛɛn, nde afàlɛŋ naa nde un'dim ande un'sak kun'pà aben.
Mɛ an'tɛn mɛ abà, ntɔn ubwaŋ abɛ ŋakwo, kà ntɔn mukàlalɛɛ untaam anki, wɛɛ ntɔn bɛ làkyer undiir aŋàbwaŋ, anà bɛ làkäl aŋàbääb a Mwol, u mpem abɛ wanswà.

Isàkal naa un'tö mwɛy kan'man naa nde ukwe anki mukaŋ mpem kusa a ŋàtàntüüm ande, isàkal naa nde wàŋàyɔl a ilään mukal anà nde anà indiir byàmulab mbwo a bya, wɛy nde ukyer ayukwen nde. Nde ukyer anki man'be: wɛy ba bàbääl.
Wɛɛ, mbuur kan'tsul u mpem ande, ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akun'siinà a ngwal, unsà ukwen ande banswà, muwal an'kyän mukɔɔn atüüb ndür a ŋàtàntüüm ande, nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ.
Abun, mbuur kan'bääl ŋàtàntüün ande, nde kan'kyer ubwaŋ, wɛɛ mbuur mpa kun'bääl kan'kyer ubwaŋ aŋàsöönà.
Un'kaar wàŋàtüüb anà un'dim ande taaŋ lanswà awà nde anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. Isàkal naa un'dim kan'kwà, nde kan'bulà wà nsaay mubääl mbuur ukwen nde, wɛɛ uboo a Mwol mpɛl.
Kyekà, kà an'kyän amɛ, nde ayàkal unsà un'sak mbɔɔn, isàkal naa nde kan'kal asànaa awà nde. Mɛ sye, mɛ in'we anà an'kyän mukal anà Dweelà a Nzam.
